sections.title: Battle Skills
sections.description: Upgrades drawn after a battle by the losing player, or by both players if the battle is a draw during campaign phases 1 and 2.

cards.name: Front-line Champion
cards.flavour: A commander who thrives at close range steadies the aim of everyone fighting nearby.
effect: When this unit attacks an enemy unit within 9", its hit rolls can be re-rolled.

cards.name: Fortune's Favoured
cards.flavour: A timely stroke of luck shields this veteran from a deadly volley.
effect: Once per battle, when attacks target this unit, this model may activate the skill. The unit has a 4+ invulnerable save until those attacks have been resolved.

cards.name: Lead from the Front
cards.flavour: The force follows a leader who is already moving toward the enemy.
effect: This unit gains Scouts 6".

cards.name: Born Survivor
cards.flavour: Years of fighting have taught this warrior how to endure wounds that would fell others.
effect: This model gains Feel No Pain 6+.

bonus.effect: The model has Feel No Pain 5+ instead.

cards.name: Natural Leader
cards.flavour: The commander's presence holds nearby formations together when morale begins to fail.
effect: Inspiring Presence (Aura): friendly units within 9" automatically pass Battle-shock rolls, provided they are not below half-strength.

bonus.effect: Friendly units within 9" of this model also gain +1 Leadership.

cards.name: High Strategy
cards.flavour: Careful preparation gives the army more resources at the outset of battle.
effect: You start the battle with 1 CP.

bonus.effect: You start the battle with 2 CP instead.

cards.name: Tempered in Battle
cards.flavour: This leader can withdraw and immediately turn the retreat into another attack.
effect: This unit may shoot and declare a charge in a turn when it Fell Back.

bonus.effect: The unit may also start an action in a turn when it Fell Back.

cards.name: Tactical Redeployment
cards.flavour: A last-minute change of formation places key units where they will matter most.
effect: During the Redeploy Units step, choose up to three friendly units. Redeploy each or put it into Strategic Reserves; those units do not count against the Strategic Reserves limit.

cards.name: Terrifying Presence
cards.flavour: The sight of this fighter is enough to unsettle an enemy already locked in combat.
effect: At the start of the Fight phase, choose one enemy unit engaged with this unit. Your opponent makes a Battle-shock roll for the chosen unit.

bonus.effect: Subtract 1 from Battle-shock rolls caused by this skill.

sections.title: Battle Honours
sections.description: The victor draws from the current phase's deck after battles in phases 1 and 2. Phase 3 awards Path to Conquest to the victor.

cards.name: Shadow Stalker
cards.flavour: This fighter uses smoke and ruined ground to stay out of the enemy's sights.
effect: This unit gains Stealth.

cards.name: Undying Duty
cards.flavour: Even as they fall, the warrior's followers strike back at their attackers.
effect: In the Fight phase, after an enemy unit finishes attacks against this unit, roll one D6 for every model those attacks destroyed in this unit. Each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the attacker.

bonus.effect: Each successful 5+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds instead.

cards.name: Grim Veterans
cards.flavour: A hardened retinue keeps its position under intense pressure.
effect: While this unit is not Battle-shocked, its models gain +1 Objective Control.

bonus.effect: Leadership rolls for this unit can be re-rolled.

cards.name: Kingslayer
cards.flavour: The champion has become adept at reaching enemy commanders through the melee.
effect: This model's melee weapons gain Precision. Re-roll its hit rolls when its attacks target a CHARACTER unit.

cards.name: Fire and Fury
cards.flavour: Relentless volleys accompany the force whether it advances or holds ground.
effect: This unit's ranged weapons gain Assault and Heavy.

bonus.effect: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this model's Blast weapons.

cards.name: Wraith of Ruin
cards.flavour: Ash and wreckage conceal the force until it is close enough to strike.
effect: Enemy models cannot see this unit unless they are within 18" of it.

cards.name: Swift as the Wind
cards.flavour: The commander's formation crosses the battlefield with unexpected speed.
effect: This unit gains +2" Move.

cards.name: Battle Hungry
cards.flavour: The unit surges toward combat and rarely misses its chance to close.
effect: Charge rolls for this unit can be re-rolled.

bonus.effect: Advance rolls for this unit can also be re-rolled.

cards.name: Ferocious Combatant
cards.flavour: Close combat grows more violent wherever this fighter leads.
effect: This unit's melee weapons gain Sustained Hits 1.

bonus.effect: This model's melee weapons also gain Cleave 1.

cards.name: Breach and Burn
cards.flavour: At short range, the unit's firepower drives enemies from cover.
effect: In your Shooting phase, this unit's attacks against an enemy unit within 18" gain Ignores Cover.

cards.name: Path to Conquest
cards.flavour: The last victory decides which alliance claims the final battlefield.
effect: At the end of campaign phase 3, the alliance with the most Phase 3 Battle Honours takes control of the Phase 3 Location.

sections.title: Relics
sections.description: Alliance-specific upgrades obtained from Agenda Achieved cards at the end of campaign phases 1 and 2.

cards.name: Blade of Sacrifice
cards.flavour: A martyr's blade converts the bearer's own vitality into devastating melee power.
cards.who: One CHARACTER model, excluding EPIC HEROES.
effect: When this unit is selected to fight, its bearer may lose 1, 2 or 3 wounds, but never more than it has remaining. Until the end of the phase, each wound lost this way gives its melee weapons +1 Attacks, +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

cards.name: Strategic Laurels
cards.flavour: A tactical data network rewards the bearer for securing ground.
effect: In your Command phase, if this unit controls an objective, make a Leadership roll for it. Gain 1 CP if the roll succeeds.

cards.name: The Emperor's Tarot
cards.flavour: A reading offers the commander a chance to reshape the mission ahead.
effect: At the start of your first Command phase, if you use Fixed Missions, exchange one of them for a different Fixed Mission of your choice.
If you use Tactical Missions, inspect the top three cards of your Tactical Missions deck and return them face down in any order.

cards.name: Vortex Grenade
cards.flavour: A miniature warp breach devastates a nearby target and threatens its thrower.
effect: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to shoot in your Shooting phase, choose an unengaged enemy unit within 8" of this model.
Roll three D6. Each result of 2+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds on that enemy unit.
Then make one Hazard roll for this unit.

cards.name: Master-crafted Armour
cards.flavour: Exceptional armour lets the bearer survive blows that would breach ordinary plate.
cards.who: One CHARACTER model, excluding EPIC HEROES.
effect: This model gains a 4+ invulnerable save.
Increase its Toughness, Save and Wounds characteristics by 1.

cards.name: Powerfield Projector
cards.flavour: The field catches incoming fire and sometimes throws its force back at the shooter.
cards.who: One CHARACTER model, excluding EPIC HEROES.
effect: This unit gains a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.
For each unmodified saving throw of 6 against ranged attacks, the attacking unit suffers 1 mortal wound after its attacks are resolved.

cards.name: Ruinator
cards.flavour: A dangerous weapon grows more destructive as the battle wears on.
cards.who: One CHARACTER model, excluding EPIC HEROES.
effect: Once per battle, when this unit is selected to fight, choose one melee weapon on this model. Until the end of the phase it gains Devastating Wounds and Hazardous.
Also increase that weapon's Attacks and Strength by half the current battle round number, rounded up.

cards.name: Temporal Talisman
cards.flavour: A stasis field grants the bearer an instant of advantage before blows land.
cards.who: One CHARACTER model, excluding EPIC HEROES.
effect: This unit gains Fights First.

cards.name: Personal Teleporter
cards.flavour: An unstable teleport device allows a sudden battlefield arrival.
effect: This unit gains Deep Strike.
Once per battle, you may target this unit with Rapid Ingress for 0 CP.

cards.name: Enhanced Bionics
cards.flavour: Self-repairing implants can restore the bearer even after a seemingly fatal blow.
effect: In your Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

The first time it is destroyed, remove it. At the end of that phase roll a D6, adding 2 if it is INFANTRY or MOUNTED. On 4+, set it up as close as possible to where it fell, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining.

cards.name: Maelstrom Clarion
cards.flavour: Disruptive signals interfere with an enemy's arrival near the bearer.
effect: Enemy units making an ingress move cannot be set up within 12" of this model.

cards.name: Displacer Field
cards.flavour: A brief warp jump pulls the bearer clear of concentrated fire.
effect: Once per battle, at the end of your opponent's Shooting phase, if this unit is unengaged and was targeted by attacks that phase, you may remove it and place it in Strategic Reserves.
On its next ingress move, it gains Deep Strike until that move ends.

cards.name: Disruption Orb
cards.flavour: The orb's signal makes nearby enemy orders harder to coordinate.
effect: Agent of Discord (Aura): when an opponent's Stratagem targets an enemy unit within 12" of this model, that use costs 1 additional CP.

cards.name: Fate-forged Weapon
cards.flavour: A weapon of infamous history strikes harder and finds vulnerable points.
cards.who: One CHARACTER model, excluding EPIC HEROES.
effect: This model's melee weapons gain +1 Armour Penetration and +1 Damage.
In the Fight phase, wound rolls for this model's attacks can be re-rolled.

cards.name: Cloak of Shadows
cards.flavour: The cloak conceals its bearer from conventional and unnatural senses alike.
cards.who: One CHARACTER model, excluding EPIC HEROES.
effect: This unit gains Infiltrators.
